minutes.headline: Commission authorized a response to a second open meeting law complaint and approved a warrant article for the cemetery.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with a dispute over recording and two critical public comments about the commission's authority. Attorney Costa presented a proposed response to a second open meeting law complaint, which the commission voted to authorize. The commission approved the prior minutes and a warrant article, and the chair pressed the DPW director on the Rainmaker database, plot refunds, and plot counts.

public_comment.topic: Criticized the wall plan, accepting donations before town approval, the commission's authority under Chapter 114, and the conduct of commissioners.
Read the charter's powers and duties of the cemetery commission and said the line between day-to-day care and regulation is unclear.
Yielded her three minutes to John Bowen.
Said the select board member's involvement in rule changes is a conflict of interest and that the commission has power only over lots.

Accept the budget and a warrant article for the cemetery commission.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to accept its attorney's recommended response to a second open meeting law complaint; the outcome of the vote was not audible.
The commission passed a motion accepting the budget and a warrant article for the cemetery commission.
The DPW director is to report at the next meeting on whether the Rainmaker database is up to date and how it will be completed.
The chair asked why two plot fee refunds were paid from the commission budget without the commission being told.
Public comment questioned the commission's authority under Chapter 114 and criticized a proposed wall at North Cemetery that is funded by a donation.

why_it_matters: The warrant article is the cemetery's request that Town Meeting voters will be asked to act on, so it bears on what the town is asked to fund for cemetery care.
Questions about who may approve refunds, accept gifts such as the wall donation, and whether the plot records in Rainmaker are complete bear on how cemetery money and plot ownership are tracked.
watch_next: The DPW director's report on the Rainmaker database at the commission's next meeting.
A meeting with the historical commission chair, which the minutes say is to be invited before March 14th.
